decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Location Plan

Condition : 3 - Hours of Opening/Use - The use hereby permitted shall be as follows:

00:00-00:00 (24 hours) Monday - Saturday
08:00 - 22:00 Sundays and Bank Holidays 

No staff shall be present at the premises one hour after the closing time.

Condition : 4 - Within 3 months of the date of this decision, a Noise and Neighbour Safety Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include, but not be limited to:


- Measures to manage and minimise noise associated with customers, staff, deliveries, and vehicle movements


- Procedures for preventing and responding to antisocial behaviour


- Details of staff training relating to noise control and customer management


- A complaints procedure including response times and record-keeping
- 

Measures to ensure safe access and egress for customers during late-night and early-morning hours

- Contact details for a responsible on-site or on-call manager



The approved Plan shall be implemented in full within 1 month of its approval and shall thereafter be adhered to for the lifetime of the development unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.


Reason:  
To safeguard the amenities, safety and wellbeing of neighbouring occupiers and the surrounding area, and to ensure the development operates in a manner that minimises noise and antisocial behaviour, in accordance with Policies D1 and D4 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies EC13.1 of the Merton Local Plan (2024).

Condition : 5 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.

In this instance:
i) The application was acceptable as submitted, and approved without delay

Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE:

Neighbours and customers are advised that any incidents of antisocial behaviour, crime, or safety concerns associated with the premises should be reported to the Metropolitan Police via:
https://www.met.police.uk


Concerns relating to noise, nuisance, or antisocial behaviour may also be reported to the London Borough of Merton Antisocial Behaviour Team via:
https://www.merton.gov.uk/community-safety/anti-social-behaviour
